## yandex

```
Usage: yandex [OPTIONS] [COMMAND] [ARGS]...

  Command line interface to Yandex Tracker and Yandex Wiki.

  Tracker commands live under `yandex tracker ...`, Wiki commands under `yandex wiki ...`.

Options:
  --json                   Machine-readable JSON output.
  --profile TEXT           Configuration profile to use.
  --env-file TEXT          dotenv file with TRACKER_* variables.
  --token TEXT             OAuth token (TRACKER_TOKEN).
  --iam-token TEXT         IAM token (TRACKER_IAM_TOKEN).
  --org-id TEXT            On-premise organization id.
  --cloud-org-id TEXT      Yandex Cloud organization id.
  --api-base-url TEXT      Tracker API base URL.
  --wiki-base-url TEXT     Wiki API base URL.
  --timeout FLOAT          HTTP timeout, seconds.
  --read-only              Refuse Tracker write commands.
  --wiki-read-only         Refuse Wiki write commands.
  --limit-queues TEXT      Comma-separated allowed queues.
  --read-only-queues TEXT  Comma-separated queues that stay readable but refuse writes.
  --session TEXT           Session file path.
  --version                Show the version and exit.
  --help                   Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  completion  Print the shell completion script for SHELL.
  config      Inspect configuration, verify access, manage profiles.
  export      Write results to files.
  repl        Interactive session (the default when no subcommand is given).
  session     Current context, audit trail and undo.
  skill       The agent skill file that ships with this CLI.
  tracker     Yandex Tracker: queues, issues, boards, sprints, users, projects.
  wiki        Yandex Wiki pages, tables, files, comments and access.
```

## yandex completion

```
Usage: yandex completion [OPTIONS] {bash|zsh|fish}

  Print the shell completion script for SHELL.

    bash:  yandex completion bash >> ~/.bashrc
    zsh:   yandex completion zsh  >> ~/.zshrc
    fish:  yandex completion fish > ~/.config/fish/completions/yandex.fish

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.
```

## yandex config

```
Usage: yandex config [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Inspect configuration, verify access, manage profiles.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  backend         Show which backend package the CLI drives.
  check           Verify the backend, credentials and API reachability.
  delete-profile  Delete a profile.
  list-profiles   List saved profiles.
  set-profile     Create or update a profile in the config file.
  show            Print the effective configuration (secrets masked).
  use-profile     Make a profile the active one.
```

## yandex export

```
Usage: yandex export [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Write results to files.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  issues  Run a query and write every matching issue to a file.
```

## yandex export issues

```
Usage: yandex export issues [OPTIONS]

  Run a query and write every matching issue to a file.

Options:
  -q, --query TEXT        Tracker query language filter.  [required]
  -o, --output TEXT       Destination file.  [required]
  --format [json|csv|md]  [default: json]
  --column TEXT           Column path (csv/md).
  --limit INTEGER         Stop after N issues.
  --per-page INTEGER      [default: 100]
  --order TEXT            Server-side sort, e.g. '-updatedAt'.
  --with-description      Keep descriptions.
  --overwrite             Replace an existing file.
  --help                  Show this message and exit.
```

## yandex session

```
Usage: yandex session [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Current context, audit trail and undo.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  clear      Wipe history, undo stack and (by default) the current context.
  history    Show recorded write operations.
  status     Show the session state.
  undo       Revert the most recent undoable operation.
  use-issue  Set (or clear) the current issue.
  use-queue  Set (or clear) the current queue.
```

## yandex skill

```
Usage: yandex skill [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  The agent skill file that ships with this CLI.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  install  Install SKILL.md where your coding agent looks for skills.
  path     Print the absolute path to SKILL.md.
  show     Print SKILL.md, for piping into an agent's own instruction format.
```

## yandex skill install

```
Usage: yandex skill install [OPTIONS]

  Install SKILL.md where your coding agent looks for skills.

Options:
  -a, --agent [claude-code|codex|copilot|cursor|gemini|universal]
                                  Agent to install for; repeatable. Omit to be asked.
  -g, --global                    Install for the current user instead of this directory.
  --project                       Install into the current directory. The default when asked.
  --dir PATH                      Explicit directory; bypasses the agent layout entirely.
  -y, --yes                       Do not prompt; take the defaults.
  --help                          Show this message and exit.
```

## yandex tracker

```
Usage: yandex tracker [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Yandex Tracker: queues, issues, boards, sprints, users, projects.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  attachment  Temporary files, uploaded before they are referenced.
  automation  Queue triggers and auto-actions.
  board       Agile boards, their columns and their sprints.
  entity      Projects, portfolios and goals (the entities API).
  field       Organization-wide metadata.
  issue       Issues: search, read, write, comments, checklists, links, files.
  project     Projects of the older v3/projects resource.
  queue       Queues: metadata, fields, components, permissions, macros.
  sprint      Sprints: read, create, start, archive.
  template    Issue and comment templates configured in Tracker settings.
  user        Organization users.
```

## yandex tracker attachment

```
Usage: yandex tracker attachment [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Temporary files, uploaded before they are referenced.

Options:
```

## yandex tracker queue

```
Usage: yandex tracker queue [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Queues: metadata, fields, components, permissions, macros.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  access              Show who may do what in a queue.
  access-set          Grant or revoke access to a queue.
  component-create    Create a component in a queue.
  component-update    Edit a component.
  components          Components of the organization's queues.
  create              Create a queue.
  delete              Delete a queue (it can be restored afterwards).
  fields              Fields usable in a queue (check schema.required before creating issues).
  get                 Queue metadata (use --expand issueTypesConfig for resolutions).
  list                List queues available to the token.
  local-field         Show one local field of a queue.
  local-field-create  Create a local field in a queue.
  local-field-update  Edit a local field of a queue.
  macro-create        Create a macro in a queue.
  macro-delete        Delete a macro.
  macro-get           Show one macro.
  macro-update        Edit a macro.
  macros              Macros of a queue.
  restore             Restore a deleted queue.
  tag-remove          Remove a tag from a queue.
  tags                Tags defined in a queue.
  version-create      Create a version in a queue.
  versions            Versions defined in a queue.
```

## yandex wiki upload

```
Usage: yandex wiki upload [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Multipart upload sessions.

  `wiki attachment upload` drives all of this for one file; reach for these commands to resume or
  script a large upload part by part.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  abort      Abandon one upload session.
  abort-all  Abandon every active upload session to free the quota.
  create     Open an upload session.
  file       Upload a file and return the finished session id.
  finish     Close an upload session so its file can be attached.
  get        Read the state of an upload session.
  part       Push one part of the file (5-16 MB, except the last).
```
